acceptance: Q28 reference-answer and equivalence tests pass unchanged on every DataFrame platform the unit and fast tiers exercise.
Before and after timings for Q28 are recorded in this item.
description:
Cleanup. TPC-DS DataFrame Q28 in `benchbox/core/tpcds/dataframe_queries/queries.py` computes `col("ss_list_price").filter(col("ss_list_price").is_not_null()).n_unique()`. Since PR #4169, `n_unique()` skips NULL on every platform, so the filter does nothing and adds an operation to a timed query on all engines. It was left alone in that change because no batch member owned it.

Expected: the filter is removed and Q28 answers are unchanged.

Guardrails: Q28 is a timed query; record before and after timing on Polars, DataFusion and PySpark and keep the change only if no platform is more than 10% slower. On DataFusion the `.filter(...)` form goes through a deferred-filter path in `unified_frame.py`; confirm the plan really gets simpler there.
